desc.short: 启发式日转夜：亮度加权的曝光下压 + 冷色温偏移 + 高光（天空）保护与轻微月光蓝移；全乘性增益保留 HDR。非真实日夜替换

params.night_depth: 夜景整体深度：驱动曝光下压（最多约 -2.3 档）与冷移强度；暗区/中间调吃满，亮区受天空保护衰减
params.temperature_shift: 冷色温偏移量（R 下沉 / B 抬升），0 为中性锚点
params.sky_protection: 亮区（≈天空）保护量：衰减下压与冷移以保留高光层次，满值时天空只剩轻微月光蓝
params.exposure: 曝光微调（档位，-3 至 +3），叠加在夜景深度驱动的下压之上

desc.short: Heuristic day-for-night look: luminance-weighted exposure pull-down, cool shift, sky highlight protection and a slight moonlight blue lift; fully multiplicative, HDR-safe. Not a real day/night replacement

params.night_depth: Overall night strength driving exposure pull-down (up to about -2.3 stops) and cool shift; shadows/midtones get the full amount, highlights are eased by Sky Protection
params.temperature_shift: Cool temperature shift amount (R sinks, B lifts), 0 is the neutral pivot
params.sky_protection: Protection for bright regions (approx. sky): eases pull-down and cool shift to keep highlight detail; at full value the sky keeps only a slight moonlight blue
params.exposure: Exposure trim in stops (-3 to +3), applied on top of the depth-driven pull-down
